title: How to Live Like the Prophet ﷺ - Session 3

clips.title: Umar Cried Hearing His Own Hadith
clips.hook: Sayyidina Umar started to cry. The sahabi said: you are literally the narrator of this hadith.
clips.overlay: He narrated the hadith himself — and still cried as if hearing it for the first time.

clips.title: Best Character Starts at Home
clips.hook: Outside they're really great. At work, at school, smiles, polite, gracious.
clips.overlay: Polite at work. Kind to strangers. A completely different person at home.

clips.title: Good Character Outweighs Everything on the Scale
clips.hook: Imagine you're on the day of judgment and the scales are placed.
clips.overlay: The HEAVIEST thing on your scale on the Day of Judgment? Good character.

clips.title: The Prophet's Response When Aisha Broke the Plate
clips.hook: That famous incident when Sayyidina Aisha broke the plate of the other wife.
clips.overlay: She broke the plate. He didn't say a word. He just said: 'Your mother had a moment.' ﷺ

clips.title: Don't Match Energy — Disarm
clips.hook: Someone could be your loved one, your friend, that could try to instigate a flare up with you.
clips.overlay: Stop matching energy. Start disarming situations.

clips.title: Imam Abu Hanifa Put His Legs Right Back Out
clips.hook: A man came to him, big beard, haybah around him, some sort of gravitas.
clips.overlay: Abu Hanifa pulled his legs in out of respect. Then the man spoke — and he put them right back out.
clips.arabic: آنَ الْأَوَانَ أَن يَمُدَّ أَبُو حَنِيفَةَ رِجْلَيْهِ

clips.title: When You're the Person People Walk on Eggshells Around
clips.hook: Imagine you are the person that people have to walk on eggshells around.
clips.overlay: You might be the person everyone walks on eggshells around — and you don't even know it.

clips.title: The Brother Who Brushed His Teeth Before Entering His Home
clips.hook: In the driveway he takes out a toothbrush and goes to the hose at the side of the house.
clips.overlay: He brushed his teeth in the driveway before walking in — because his wife deserves his best.

clips.title: Bad Character Means Incomplete Faith
clips.hook: Those who have bad character have incomplete faith. Incomplete Iman.
clips.overlay: Bad character doesn't just look bad — it means incomplete faith.

clips.title: Your Good Character Is Not Transactional
clips.hook: Good character is a principle you embody regardless of your interlocutor.
clips.overlay: Good character isn't reciprocal. It's a principle you live by.
